title: Quarterly Cohort Roadmap — SKU Bundles for Hosted Endpoints & Model Retirement Windows
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Goal: Define and publish a quarter-long roadmap that groups hosted endpoints into SKU cohorts, aligns model lifecycle windows (onboarding, canary, active, retirement), and maps capacity hedges and OKR signals to each cohort. This ticket scopes the strategy doc, sprint milestones, and cross-functional signoffs required for launch of SKU-based pricing offers and a model retirement calendar for the public catalog.

Scope includes: cohort definitions and naming, SKU feature mappings (latency tier, throughput cap, memory footprint), a model retirement policy and notification cadence, integration points for the Console (billing labels + route filters), and ops playbooks for canary/rollback across SKU cohorts. Excludes redesign of billing schema itself (separate billing-ops ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Cohort taxonomy documented with 3 SKU bundles (Standard, Performance, Enterprise) and at least one example endpoint mapped to each
Model lifecycle calendar created with onboarding/canary/active/retirement gates and owner assignments
Console product tickets created for UI tag filters and cost breakdown per SKU
SRE/Capacity has validated throughput hedges and a soft capacity commit plan for the quarter
PM leadership sign-off and public-facing roadmap entry scheduled on March product update

2026-01-25 | Diego Martinez: Eng sync — SRE flagged GPU packing trade-offs for Performance SKU (higher p99 tail risk). We agreed on a soft cap and fallback routing policy: Performance requests can overflow to Standard with reduced throughput but not exceed latency SLOs for Enterprise cohort. Action: ENG to prototype routing policy (ENG-18672 mock).

2026-02-03 | Ava Chen (Design): Shared Console filter mockups and cost allocation badge variations. PM feedback: prefer in-table tag with hover details instead of modal to reduce clicks for power users. Added to design backlog DES-1121 for iteration.

2026-02-10 | Marcus Liu (SRE): Capacity hedge simulation results attached to Confluence; suggests reserving 20% burst capacity for Performance cohort during peak hours. Recommendation accepted as a quarter-level operational leash.

2026-02-15 | Priya Kapoor: Trade-off note — limiting SKU bundles to three reduces catalog fragmentation but may hide edge-case pricing needs for high-volume enterprise customers. Decided to offer custom enterprise SLAs via sales uplift instead of adding more SKUs this quarter.
